title: Recover from structured reference error
task: You will receive a structured Battenmark error from a failed operation (GEOMETRY_REFERENCE_LOST or similar). Using only public operations: record the error, call kernel_status and/or inspect_backend_capabilities as appropriate, correct the reference using public inspection tools, retry the operation, and re-verify success. Do not call private FreeCAD Python, edit workers, or bypass the service layer.

structured_error.message: Persistent geometry reference gref_missing was lost after rebuild.
structured_error.suggestion: Inspect faces and retry with a current semantic selector such as top_face.
